title: Keep historical FX balances when unapplying payments
summary: The exchange rate revaluation date is now aligned with the entry's latest adjustment when unapplying backdated payments, preventing unrealized FX amounts from shifting between periods.
key_points: Fixes FX balance movement when unapplying backdated payments
Aligns revaluation date with latest exchange-rate adjustment
Covers vendors, customers and employees in W1 and RU
Prevents month-end balance distortion from period shifts
Includes regression tests for multiple scenarios
quote: Unapplying a backdated payment could move unrealized FX amounts between periods, changing month-end balances.
